description:
Soundscape recorded at the Spiaggia dei Castriota beach on the island of Stromboli. The microphone is positioned just above ground level, a sand of very thin black stones, a short distance from where the waves break on the beach.

One can hear the sounds of the waves of a very calm sea, some birds, a gentle wind. Some bumps derived from the handling of the microphone.

Recorded date: 16/06/2025 at 13:22 with: Zoom H1n with windscreen. Processing: no processing
name: Stromboli beach
